headline: Front Shifts Surge as Bases Trade Hands
war_summary: Since the last edition three hours ago the map has grown quieter on the two most volatile sectors. Fishermans Row, which recorded three captures in the prior two‑hour window, shows no fresh flips in the latest two hours and only three in the past six, while its 24‑hour total remains at twenty‑three. Dead Lands continues to bleed — over 1,700 colonial and 2,200 warden casualties in the last two hours — but ownership changes have slipped to fourteen in the day, down from sixteen. In contrast, Stema Landing erupted with six captures in the last six hours, all centred on The Wane, and Tempest Island logged its first recent activity with a capture at Blackwatch early this morning. Godcrofts added one new flip in the past six hours, keeping its day‑total at nine, and Lykos Isle recorded three fresh turns around Fort Guile and The Squall. The massive attrition corridors — Weathered Expanse, Callahans Passage, Kings Cage, Marban Hollow, Loch Mor, Stlican Shelf and Stonecradle — still post rising casualty rates but no territorial movement. Overall strategic‑base ownership remains largely static, with Colonials holding the western and southern belts and Wardens the northern and eastern arcs.
